descriptions.text: This holiday season, make your own gift tags and cards with the Sending Cheer Stamp Set. Stamp an image, then punch or die cut it and you have a tag—it’s quick and easy! But quick and easy doesn’t mean boring. Stamp a gift image in one color, then stamp a bow image on it in a bright ink for fun contrast. Or stamp a stack of stocking images and top each with a different color cuff. And don’t forget cards! Just imagine how festive these images will look on handmade cards.

Use the leaf images to add organic accents to other images or on a Christmas card base for some added texture. No matter how you use this set to deck your crafts, we’re sure this yuletide-themed classic Christmas set is sure to spread joy.
